name: A Wine Colored Crime
source:
Join 5 other guests for a night of fun and mystery. After an old friend sends you a party invitation out of the blue, you find yourself back in a familiar place, but this time you're joined by five other guests, each with their own reasons for attending.

[From [url=https://babydev.itch.io/a-wine-colored-crime]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
和另外五名宾客一起，度过充满欢乐与谜团的一夜。老朋友突然寄来派对邀请后，你回到了熟悉的地方；这一次，身边还有另外五名宾客，而他们每个人都有自己的赴会理由。

[来源：[url=https://babydev.itch.io/a-wine-colored-crime]itch.io[/url]]
